answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the haven seed, the saffron timing is verifiable from the wander record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 83 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is cheap once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 189 keys as a result burns 189 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
